outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: GET /api/health returned {"engine":"postgres_error: read ECONNRESET","connected":false} due to expired Railway Postgres URL (*.rlwy.net) in .env.local, and local port 3000 returned HTTP 404.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: getPostgresPool() attempted a live TCP connection to a decommissioned Railway host without falling back to the local SQLite database (dev.db).
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated lib/db/client.ts to detect and bypass dead .rlwy.net / railway.internal URLs, auto-disable pgPool on connection failure, and fall back to SQLite (dev.db) with connected: true.

outageRcaAndRemediation.symptomBefore: Cloud Run revision zyvoriq-00003-r98 failed startup probe with EACCES: permission denied, open '/app/server.js' and missing standalone node_modules.
outageRcaAndRemediation.rootCause: OCI layer tarball wrote files as uid=0 without world-read bits while container ran as User: nextjs, and omitted .next/standalone/node_modules and public/universal_feedback_widget.js.
outageRcaAndRemediation.remediationApplied: Updated oci_deploy_remaining_services.py to bundle .next/standalone/node_modules, public/universal_feedback_widget.js, public/assets/avatars, and dev.db with User: root, and deployed revision zyvoriq-00004-llt.
